Ymir: "Oh, Mr. Touya.
How was your room?"
Touya: "It's an ordinary room."
Yamato: "Hey!"
Ymir: "Yes. We only fixed up the interior,
so perhaps we played it too safe.
Would you have preferred something a little more unusual?"
Yamato: "No! It's nice, really.
He just has trouble showing he's pleased."
Touya: "Well, excuse me."
Ymir: "If you don't like it, I can change it..."
Touya: "It's not that I don't like it.
It's just that my impression was 'an ordinary room.'"
Ymir: "I see. If there's anything you need,
please don't hesitate to ask."
Touya: "Yeah, I'll do that."
Ymir: "..."
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "...Um... Was there something else?"
Touya: "..."
Ask about Ymir herself.
Ask what we'll do next.
Ymir: "About... me?"
Touya: "Yeah."
Ymir: "...Um..."
Yamato: "Honestly, why are you asking her that out of nowhere?
You're putting her on the spot."
Ymir: "Oh, I don't mind.
It's just that I don't really have anything to tell you...
I'm sorry."
Touya: "I see..."
Ask what we'll do next.
Leave.
Yamato: "Right. We can't stay here forever without any business
and get in Ymir's way."
Ymir: "You don't need to worry so much.
Please feel free to visit again."
Ymir: "What we'll do next? As I mentioned earlier,
we're currently planning to head for the Holy Land.
We'll decide what to do after that when we get there."
Touya: "And you're just going to leave York like that?"
Ymir: "There's nothing we can do as we are now,
unfortunately..."
Touya: "Sure, we can't take on an army with the forces we've got,
and I know Spirit Mechs weren't made
for that sort of thing in the first place. But..."
Yamato: "Touya, we've already talked about that.
Besides, I'm sure everyone feels the same way."
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "I'm sorry..."
Touya: "...No, you're right. It's hard on you too."
Ymir: "I'm sorry..."
Touya: "I'm the one who should apologize.
We shouldn't let our feelings drive us to revenge, right?"
Ymir: "Mr. Touya..."
Touya: "Everyone feels the same, huh... Yeah, you're right.
Sorry for being so unreasonable."
Ymir: "No, please..."
Yamato: "Well, now that we've settled that,
let's get going. We can't stay here forever without any business
and get in Ymir's way."
Ymir: "You don't need to worry so much.
Please come by anytime, without hesitation."
Touya: "Yeah, I'll do that. See you."
Ymir: "What we'll do next? As I mentioned earlier,
we're currently planning to head for Belnea Fort.
As for what comes after that, I still don't..."
Touya: "Right. First, we help liberate York."
Ymir: "Yes."
Touya: "Still, things have gotten pretty big, haven't they?
Getting caught up in a war and all."
Ymir: "I'm sorry... for dragging you into this.
But..."
Touya: "...I'm not blaming you.
I'm pissed off at what those Zigrim bastards are doing too."
Ymir: "It helps to hear you say that."
Yamato: "Well, now that we've settled that,
let's get going. We can't stay here forever without any business
and get in Ymir's way."
Ymir: "You don't need to worry so much.
Please come by anytime, without hesitation."
Touya: "Yeah, I'll do that. See you."
Ymir: "Oh, Mr. Touya. What is it?"
Touya: "Nothing. I don't really need anything, but..."
Ymir: "I see."
Yamato: "Honestly, don't bother her when you don't need anything.
Sorry to disturb you."
Touya: "...?"
Yamato: 'Shh. Someone's in there.'
Touya: 'Someone? That girl's in there, right?'
Yamato: 'No, someone else...
Oh, is that Prince Cain's voice?'
Touya: 'Huh?'
Yamato: 'It sounds like they're having a pretty serious conversation...'
Leave.
Keep eavesdropping.
Call out to them.
Touya: 'Let's go.'
Yamato: 'Huh?'
Touya: 'They're talking about something important, right?
Then we shouldn't interrupt.'
Yamato: 'Well, well...'
Touya: 'What?!'
Yamato: 'Nothing. Let's head back, then.'
Yamato: 'Hey, are you serious?!'
Touya: 'I'm kind of curious.
Aren't you?'
Yamato: '...A little.'
Cain: "...I'm glad you're safe."
Alforina: "Thank you.
I'm surprised to see Your Highness in a place like this..."
Cain: "Well, I've been disinherited, so I'm free to do as I please.
More importantly, is it all right for the castle to fall to Zigrim?
There must have been all sorts of valuable things there."
Alforina: "Yes. But I've already passed on the important things,
and erased the rest of the data.
There is no problem."
Cain: "Passed them on? I see. That's a relief..."
Alforina: "..."
Cain: "Hmm? Is there something on my face?"
Alforina: "No. It's just that, rather than looking relieved,
you seemed disappointed."
Cain: "...Heh. Impressive as ever. Is that another of your abilities?"
Alforina: "No."
Cain: "I see. ...It's true that I'm not relieved.
After all, you hold the key to unsealing that thing."
Alforina: "!! H-How do you know about that...?"
Cain: "I was once a member of the Limberg royal family too, you know.
You shouldn't underestimate that man's ability to gather information."
Alforina: "...That man? Do you mean the King of Limberg,
His Majesty Fram Zeo Isfandeil?"
Cain: "Yes. And the father who abandoned me.
Well, setting that aside, someone like Zigrim's
President Horem could easily know about it too.
That would explain this invasion as well.
So, what's the truth? Don't I at least
have the right to know that much?"
Alforina: "...I'm afraid I cannot answer.
But I do not have it, and it isn't in Flamuelk either.
Are you satisfied with that?"
Cain: "...I see. Well, in that case,
I'm somewhat relieved. But if you've entrusted it to someone,
they must be a person you trust a great deal."
Alforina: "Yes."
Cain: "I see...
Well, I shouldn't overstay my welcome,
so I think I'll be going now."
Yamato: 'Oh, Touya!'
Touya: 'Yeah, let's get out of here!'
Touya: "Excuse me."
Yamato: "Oh..."
Cain: "..."
Alforina: "Yes...?"
Cain: "Well then, I'll be off..."
Cain: "Are you two visiting her too?"
Touya: "Yeah. Have you finished your business?"
Cain: "More or less. See you."
Alforina: "Is that... Mr. Touya?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah. How are you feeling?"
Alforina: "I'm feeling much better, thank you."
Touya: "Good. By the way, what was he here for?"
Alforina: "He seems to be concerned about this world
in his own way. Though I couldn't tell his true intentions..."
Yamato: "Just like Arthur said, I wonder if he's
plotting something?"
Touya: "I don't know. He's certainly a mystery.
Though it does seem certain that he's a real prince."
Alforina: "Mr. Touya, do you still have that crystal?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah. You mean this?"
Touya: "Come to think of it, I never gave it back."
Alforina: "No, please hold on to it
a little longer."
Touya: "Huh? Well, I don't mind, but..."
Alforina: "And please avoid showing it to other people
too much. It's said that disaster will strike
if someone with a base heart sees it."
Touya: "So that means at least I'm not
someone with a base heart."
Yamato: "With the qualification 'for now,' anyway."
Touya: "Hey, you!"
Alforina: "Heh heh heh... You're very close, aren't you?"
Yamato: "Hardly! Having such a troublesome little brother
is a lot of work."
Touya: "Who's your little brother?!"
Yamato: "In human years, I'm a perfectly respectable
big sister, you knyow."
Touya: "Converting your age to human years is the problem to begin with."
Yamato: "Oh, listen to you splitting hairs..."
Touya: "You're the one doing that!"
Alforina: "Heh heh heh heh...
You two really are entertaining."
Gabon: "Oh, visiting her, eh? That's good of you."
Yamato: "Whoa! You startled me!"
Gabon: "Gahahaha! Sorry, sorry.
Visiting is all well and good, but think about her needs too.
What Her Majesty needs right now is sleep."
Alforina: "I'm all right, really."
Gabon: "That won't do. Come on, visiting time's over.
You can talk when she's feeling better."
Touya: "Yeah, okay. See you, then."
Yamato: "Bye-bye."
Alforina: "Yes. Thank you for coming."
Ymir: "Oh, Mr. Touya. What is it?
Do you have another question?"
Touya: "Yeah. If you're busy, I can come back later..."
Ymir: "No, it's all right.
What is it?"
Touya: "You said you weren't comfortable with
being praised or admired, right?
I was wondering about what you started to say back then, Ymir..."
Ymir: "..."
Touya: "Is it something that's hard to talk about?"
Ymir: "...It's not a very nice story..."
Touya: "That's okay."
Ymir: "..."
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "............At some point,
the expectant looks everyone gave me
started to hurt."
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "Of course, that didn't mean I ran away.
I worked hard to meet their expectations at the time."
Yamato: "You're a hard worker."
Ymir: "...No. I was just afraid of the disappointment
I'd see in their eyes if I let them down.
I was just afraid of getting hurt..."
Touya: "Ymir..."
Ymir: "See? It's not a nice story, is it?"
Touya: "But you worked so hard, Ymir, and that's why
we have today's Ymir and today's Spirit Mechs, right?
Besides, nobody wants to be disliked."
Ymir: "..."
Touya: "Everyone's afraid of getting hurt.
And, Ymir, the effort you've put in to get this far
is something no one can deny."
Ymir: "Mr. Touya..."
Touya: "Oh, I'm starting to sound kind of high and mighty.
Sorry."
Ymir: "No. Thank you.
I'm glad I told you, Mr. Touya."
Touya: "R-Really?"
Ymir: "Yes. You're very kind."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Aww, you're blushing! How cute!"
Touya: "Shut up."
Ymir: "Heh heh heh."
Touya: "Th-That's all I wanted to ask. See you."
Yamato: "Oh, h-hey! Wait for me!"
Ymir: "I'm sorry."
Touya: "I see..."
Ymir: "It's not really something to tell other people... I'm sorry."
Touya: "Okay. Sorry to bother you. See you."
